Evidence/VIS-MFI-SPINE
Evidence record

Microfinance observations by date, with gaps and breaks shown

What does this evidence establish?

Figures reported by microfinance programmes and providers supported by the Social Fund for Development (SFD) exist at dated points from 31 December 2010 to 31 December 2020, not at every year-end. In 2015, three snapshots show active borrowers falling from 124,917 at end-March to 93,118 at end-December; the 2018 portfolio value is not published here because its verification is incomplete; 2019 has only a first-quarter observation; February 2021 figures are available only through a Yemen Microfinance Network (YMN) document that cites SFD; and no primary observation has been located for 2022 or 2024. The end-2023 figure comes from a secondary source whose provider set has not been verified and is not joined to these observations. There is no continuous annual series.

What does it measure?

Active borrowers, savers and outstanding loan portfolio (nominal Yemeni rials) reported by SFD-supported microfinance programmes and providers at each dated observation from 2010 to 2024, with years that have no usable observation marked as gaps.

Who or what does it apply to?

Microfinance programme observations and reporting populations as each source and date defines them, with changes in reporting scope kept visible.

When was it measured or observed?

2010–2024 evidence horizon available here

How current is it?

The latest SFD observation in this record is dated 31 December 2020. February 2021 figures exist only through a secondary pointer, and no primary observation has been located for 2022 or 2024, so the record should not be read as describing microfinance after 2020.

What this evidence does not establish

It gives no values between observed dates, a quarter-end figure does not stand in for a missing year-end, and held or contradictory portfolio values are not settled figures. Each observation keeps its own reporting coverage and evidence state, so the points do not form one continuous or national series.

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How can I verify it?

This record is drawn from the source(s) listed on this page. Open a source record to reach the original document, and check that the definition, period, population and geography match what is stated here.

How should this record be read?

Read this evidence within the definition, population or group covered, calculation base where relevant, period, geography and method shown on the page. Before reusing or comparing it, check the source, limitations, evidence date and correction history. If a value or source link is unavailable, the page says so rather than filling the gap by inference. This resource does not host source files; where an original-source link is given, check the publisher’s terms before republishing.
